00046 SpawnBaseUGenInternal::SpawnBaseUGenInternal(const int numInputs, const int _numChannels, const int maxRepeats) throw()

00048   numChannels(_numChannels),

00055   ugen_assert(maxRepeats >= 0);

00065 void SpawnBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00066 {   
00067   if(reachedMaxRepeats() == true && events.sizeNotNull() == 0) shouldDelete = true;
00068   
00069   if(shouldStopAllEvents() == true) initEvents();
00070   
00071   events.removeNulls(); //
00072   
00073   const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();  
00074   const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00075   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00076   {
00077     bufferData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00078   }
00079   
00080   mixer.prepareForBlock(numSamplesToProcess, blockID, -1);
00081   mixer.setOutputs(bufferData, numSamplesToProcess, numChannels);
00082   mixer.processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00083 }

00112 SpawnUGenInternal::SpawnUGenInternal(const int numChannels, const double nextTime_, const int maxRepeats) throw()
00113 : SpawnBaseUGenInternal(0, numChannels, maxRepeats),

00120 void SpawnUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00121 {
00122   // render the current voices
00123   SpawnBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00124   
00125   const unsigned int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00126   const unsigned int nextBlockID = blockID + blockSize;
00127   
00128   if(nextTimeSamples < nextBlockID && reachedMaxRepeats() == false)
00129   {
00130     // now overdub new voices this block
00131       
00132     if(nextTimeSamples < blockID)
00133       nextTimeSamples = blockID;
00134     
00135     const int blockOffset = nextTimeSamples - blockID;
00136     int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize - blockOffset;  
00137     const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00138     
00139     if(blockOffset > 0)
00140     {
00141       for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00142       {
00143         bufferData[channel] += blockOffset;
00144       }
00145     }
00146     
00147     do
00148     {
00149       UGen newVoice = spawnEvent(*this, currentEventIndex++);
00150       newVoice.prepareForBlock(blockSize, blockID, -1); // prepare for full size (allocates the output buffers)
00151       
00152 //      UGen::setBlockSize(numSamplesToProcess);
00153       newVoice.prepareForBlock(numSamplesToProcess, nextTimeSamples, -1); // prepare for sub block
00154       
00155       unsigned int nextTimeSamplesDelta = (unsigned int)(nextTime * UGen::getSampleRate());
00156       
00157       for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00158       {
00159         bool shouleDeleteLocal = false;
00160         float *voiceSamples = newVoice.processBlock(shouleDeleteLocal, nextTimeSamples, channel);
00161         accumulateSamples(bufferData[channel], voiceSamples, numSamplesToProcess);
00162         bufferData[channel] += nextTimeSamplesDelta;
00163       }
00164       
00165       //events <<= newVoice;
00166       events.add(newVoice);
00167 
00168       numSamplesToProcess -= nextTimeSamplesDelta;
00169       nextTimeSamples += nextTimeSamplesDelta;
00170     } 
00171     while(nextTimeSamples < nextBlockID && reachedMaxRepeats() == false);
00172     
00173 //    UGen::setBlockSize(blockSize); // reset
00174     
00175     //mixer = Mix(&events, false);    
00176     events.removeNulls();
00177   }
00178 }
